message.skyabyss.young.stone_whale.calle: The calf answers the whale's song. A small stone whale rises at your feet.
message.skyabyss.young.stone_whale.seate: You sit in the calf's saddle. Pick a destination on the chart (up to 6 riders; party members board by right-click or by blowing their call). Blow your call to reopen the chart.
You sit in the calf's saddle. %s decides the destination.
message.skyabyss.young.stone_whale.depar: The calf rises above the clouds, bound for %s.
message.skyabyss.young.stone_whale.veil: The calf dives into the sea of clouds. In the white dark, it felt like a long while passed.
message.skyabyss.young.stone_whale.arriv: The calf sets you down at %s and dissolves into song.
message.skyabyss.young.recognized.stone_: The stone whale's song echoed deep in your chest. The titan remembers you now.
message.skyabyss.young.tide_shell.called: The hatchling answers the shell's call. A small shell drifts up on the water.
message.skyabyss.young.tide_shell.seated: You sit on the hatchling's shell. Pick a destination on the tide chart (up to 6 riders; party members board by right-click or by blowing their conch). Blow your conch to reopen the chart.
You sit on the hatchling's shell. %s decides the destination.
message.skyabyss.young.tide_shell.depart: The hatchling slides off across the water, bound for %s.
message.skyabyss.young.tide_shell.veil: The hatchling sinks into a deep current. In the blue dark, you heard a distant sea song.
message.skyabyss.young.tide_shell.arrive: The hatchling sets you down near %s and melts into the tide.
message.skyabyss.young.recognized.tide_s: You heard the tide rising deep in your chest. The titan remembers you now.
message.skyabyss.young.thunder_wing.call: The fledgling answers the feather's call. Down gathers out of the wind into a shape.
message.skyabyss.young.thunder_wing.seat: You sit on the fledgling's back. Pick a destination on the ridge chart (up to 6 riders; party members board by right-click or by raising their quill). Raise your quill to reopen the chart.
You sit on the fledgling's back. %s decides the destination.
message.skyabyss.young.thunder_wing.depa: The fledgling spreads its wings and skims the ridgelines, bound for %s.
message.skyabyss.young.thunder_wing.veil: The fledgling dives under the thunderhead. In the white flashes, it felt like a long while passed.
message.skyabyss.young.thunder_wing.arri: The fledgling sets you down at %s and fades into the wind.
message.skyabyss.young.recognized.thunde: Far thunder rolled deep in your chest. The titan remembers you now.
message.skyabyss.young.ember.called: The whelp answers the bell. Ash at your feet sets into the shape of a small beast.
message.skyabyss.young.ember.seated_lead: You sit on the whelp's saddle. Pick a destination on the ash chart (up to 6 riders; party members board by right-click or by ringing their bell). Ring your bell to reopen the chart.
message.skyabyss.young.ember.seated: You sit on the whelp's back. %s decides the destination.
message.skyabyss.young.ember.depart: The whelp kicks off and runs, bound for %s.
message.skyabyss.young.ember.veil: The whelp drops into a stream of hot ash. In the red dark, it felt like a long while passed.
message.skyabyss.young.ember.arrived: The whelp sets you down at %s and crumbles back into ash.
message.skyabyss.young.recognized.ember: An ember popped softly deep in your chest. The titan remembers you now.
message.skyabyss.young.recognized_hint: You got a call. Blow it and the titan's young one appears; you and your party (up to 6) can ride it to a destination.
message.skyabyss.young.not_now: You cannot choose a destination right now.
message.skyabyss.young.chosen: Destination: %s. We leave once your party is aboard.
message.skyabyss.young.cancelled: The owner got off. The destination must be chosen again.
message.skyabyss.young.countdown_wait: Leaving in %s s. %s party member(s) not aboard yet
message.skyabyss.young.mate_calling: %s's young one leaves soon (%s s). Right-click it or blow your call to board
message.skyabyss.young.no_dismount: You cannot get off until we arrive.
message.skyabyss.young.have_one: Your young one is already out. Go to it and right-click or blow your call.
message.skyabyss.young.not_yours: This is %s's young one. Only party members can ride.
message.skyabyss.young.too_late: The young one has already left.
message.skyabyss.young.arrived_titan: We reached %s. The titan does not move. Step down into the ring of light.
message.skyabyss.young.arrived_titan_hin: Stand in the ring of light to enter its back. Only your party can see it.
message.skyabyss.young.refuse.no_sea: No water nearby for %s to slide out on. Blow it near the shore (within 24 blocks of water).
message.skyabyss.young.refuse.no_room: No room for %s's young one to appear. Blow it in a more open spot.
message.skyabyss.young.dissolved.gone: The one who called it is gone; the young one returned to song.
message.skyabyss.young.dissolved.faded: The young one grew tired of waiting and returned to song.
message.skyabyss.young.dissolved.blocked: The way was blocked and the young one dissolved. You were set down on the ground.
gui.skyabyss.young.lock.too_far: Too far for this young one
